message.content:
Sugammadex is a modified gamma-cyclodextrin. Cyclodextrins are classified in 2940 (sugars, chemically pure, and their derivatives) or in 3824, and the sodium salt of sugammadex is a complex organic compound. In a formulated injection put up in dosage form, the heading is 3004.

Within 3004, the candidates are 3004.90 (other medicaments) and its statistical subdivisions. Sugammadex (Bridion) CBP rulings place it in 3004.90.92 ("Other"), and the 10-digit number I recall for it is 3004.90.9290. I did not verify that against a ruling.

3004.90.92 covers "Other" medicaments, and statistical suffix 90 would be "Other". The 3004.90.92 line has several suffixes, and 90 is the residual one I am settling on.

{"hts_code": "3004.90.9290", "reason": "Sugammadex injection is a medicament of mixed or unmixed products put up in measured doses for retail/therapeutic use, falling under heading 3004 as an 'other' medicament."}
